---
title: "D3 Retention Graph Report"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Load Data (D3)

```{r}
d3 <- read_csv("D3.csv")
```

```{r}
d3$creat_date <- as.Date(d3$creat_date)
```

## Plot Graph (D3)

```{r}
ggplot(d3, aes(x = creat_date, y = D3_Retention_percent)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "D3 Retention Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Retention (%)"
  )
```
